summaryDaily: WITH days AS (SELECT key AS day, value AS start, lead(value) OVER (ORDER BY key) AS end FROM json_each(@boundaries))
SELECT d.start, count(s.id) AS count, coalesce(sum(s.total),0) AS total, coalesce(sum(s.paid),0) AS paid
FROM days d LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.date>=d.start AND s.date<d.end
AND (@allowedWarehouses IS NULL OR s.warehouse IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(@allowedWarehouses)))
AND (@allowedAccounts IS NULL OR s.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(@allowedAccounts)))
WHERE d.end IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.day,d.start ORDER BY d.day
